about: Keyframes: each emote's Blender animation (fabric/tools/blender/emote_anims.py, emote_video.py) sampled 32 times a loop. t is 0..1 of the loop. Angles in degrees: armX/legX swing forward (+) / back (-), armZ/legZ out to the side (+); bodyYaw turns the whole body; above the hips the body twists (to its right), leans (forward) and tilts (to its right); the head nods (down), turns (to its right) and tilts (to its right); the elbows bend the forearm forward and the knees the shin back (0 = straight); bounce lifts the body (studs).
